_comment: Illustrative unit economics for a mixed-model assembly line. Directional figures, stated as assumptions - not a claim about any specific plant. Every ROI number in the dashboard and the business proposal is computed from these inputs plus MEASURED detector performance; nothing is hardcoded downstream.

assumptions._max_recoverable_share_note: Hard cap on recovered production as a share of annual volume, so the model cannot claim more than a plausible ceiling.

actionability._comment: Fraction of correctly-detected incidents the floor can actually act on, as a function of detection lead time in vehicles. Linearly interpolated; beyond the last point the value is held flat.

sensitivity._comment: Fractional band applied to the two dominant assumptions when reporting a range.
